facts.business: Enbee Trade and Finance Limited is an RBI-licensed, BSE-listed Non-Deposit Accepting Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) primarily engaged in granting unsecured loans to body corporates and individuals.
key_risks: Impairment of Loans – Expected Credit Losses involving significant management judgement and estimation in classification/staging of loan exposures, identification of significant increase in credit risk, probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), exposure at default (EAD), historical loss experience, recovery estimates and macroeconomic factors.
